title: An `[[app]]` block may widen a limit or grant a capability up to the global ceiling, and may only lower its own ceiling
divergesFromPhp: a per-directory `php.ini` can only move what `PHP_INI_PERDIR` allows; an `[[app]]` block sets any `[app.limits]` value up to `[limits.hard]` and grants a capability the global block withholds, so the root file denies and each application states what it needs
